verdict.rationale: Khoj lets users keep data out of any third-party training pipeline indirectly. It can be self-hosted so data is never shared outside the device, and it can run offline/local chat models via Ollama. That workaround depends on the user running the full stack locally rather than on an explicit training policy or control. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment or opt-out for Khoj Cloud, documentation on whether data sent to configured online LLM providers may be used for training, and independent corroboration of a fully local setup.
